Ball Drop is intentionally simple. The goal is not to prove we can build the world's most complicated game — it is to prove the HPL economy can function safely from end to end.

Early Alpha MVP • Base Sepolia

HPL Ball Drop

A basic playable loop built to test the economics and infrastructure behind HPL: trading, token utility, reflections, power-ups, game rewards, claims, and wallet interactions.

✓Trade TEST-HPL through a live test liquidity pool.
✓Earn and claim holder reflections on-chain.
✓Spend HPL on in-game power-ups without gameplay tax.
✓Compete in rounds and claim finalized HPL game rewards.
✓Help us identify bugs, exploits, edge cases, and bad assumptions.

Follow Development
Development Direction

Test first. Harden second. Expand third.

This roadmap is intentionally high level. Alpha discoveries may change priorities, architecture, tokenomics, and gameplay before anything approaches a production launch.

Now • Alpha

Prove the full HPL loop

Ball Drop, trading, reflections, marketplace spending, automated rewards, claims, mobile/tablet UX, and backend integration.

Next

Try to break it

Community play testing, adversarial score testing, smart-contract edge cases, original-exploit regression tests, wallet flows, and backend hardening.

Then

Refine the contracts

Revisit reward allocation across multiple games, liquidity-funding options, wallet connectivity, security boundaries, and upgrade/migration strategy.

Before Mainnet

Professional review and audit

Freeze the intended contract design, conduct security review/auditing, resolve findings, and repeat testing before putting meaningful liquidity at risk.

Later

Grow beyond the proving ground

Expand the game library, revisit HPL Bingo, improve onboarding, and gradually move toward a more polished game-first experience.

MetaMask quick-start guide

Choose your device. Already have a wallet? Skip to adding Base Sepolia.

1. Install and create your wallet

  1. Visit MetaMask’s official download page and install the iPhone or Android app.
  2. Open MetaMask and choose Create a new wallet. For this guide, choose Secret Recovery Phrase if asked.
  3. Set a strong password. Write your 12 recovery words on paper in the exact order shown, then complete the confirmation.

2. Add Base Sepolia

  1. In the Tokens tab, tap the network dropdown.
  2. Choose Custom → Add a custom network.
  3. Enter the settings below and tap Save or Add.

3. Open the game inside MetaMask

  1. Tap Explore, then the browser icon.
  2. Open the Ball Drop Alpha game in that browser.
  3. Tap Connect Wallet, choose MetaMask, review the request and connect.
  4. If asked to switch networks, approve Base Sepolia. Your wallet must be approved for Alpha access.

1. Install and create your wallet

  1. Visit MetaMask’s official download page and install its extension in the browser you will use to play.
  2. Open MetaMask and choose Create a new wallet. For this guide, choose Secret Recovery Phrase if asked.
  3. Set a strong password. Write your 12 recovery words on paper in the exact order shown, then complete the confirmation.

2. Add Base Sepolia

  1. Open MetaMask’s upper-right menu and select Networks.
  2. Select Add a custom network.
  3. Enter the settings below and click Save.

3. Connect to the game

  1. Click Continue to Game above, using the browser where you installed MetaMask.
  2. Click Connect Wallet, select MetaMask and unlock it if prompted.
  3. Review the request and click Connect. Approve switching to Base Sepolia if asked.

Choose Base Sepolia—not Base mainnet or Ethereum Sepolia. Menu names can vary by MetaMask version. If the game still shows the wrong network, open its connected-site icon in MetaMask and select Base Sepolia.

Your recovery words stay private. HPL will never need your recovery phrase or private key. Only share your public wallet address to request access or test funds.

Need test funds?

Base Sepolia test ETH pays test transaction fees. Ask the HPL team on Telegram for test-funding instructions. You do not need to buy real ETH for this Alpha.
